[[File:Great triakis octahedron.stl|thumb|3D model of a great triakis octahedron]]
In [[geometry]], the '''great triakis octahedron''' is the dual of the [[stellated truncated hexahedron]] (U<sub>19</sub>). It has 24 intersecting [[Triangle#Types of triangle|isosceles triangle]] faces. Part of each triangle lies within the solid, hence is invisible in solid models.

== Proportions ==
The triangles have one angle of <math>\arccos(\frac{1}{4}+\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{2})\approx 16.842\,116\,236\,30^{\circ}</math> and two of <math>\arccos(\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{4}\sqrt{2})\approx 81.578\,941\,881\,85^{\circ}</math>. The [[dihedral angle]] equals <math>\arccos(\frac{-3+8\sqrt{2}}{17})\approx 60.722\,386\,809\,64^{\circ}</math>.
